summary: A spacious, casual northern Thai restaurant behind Chiang Mai University in the Wat Umong area, with a menu of more than 200 mostly regional dishes. It suits a shared meal focused on dips, grilled sausage, curries and seasonal specialties.
whyGo: Try a sampler-style northern platter alongside lesser-known local dishes in one meal.
The restaurant reports indoor and open-air seating and capacity for about 300; recent diners mention air-conditioned seating and parking.
bestFor: Groups and families who want to share several small plates.
Visitors already exploring Wat Umong or the Chiang Mai University area.
skipIf: You need a guaranteed vegan or allergy-safe kitchen; ingredient handling and cross-contact policies are not published.
You want a central Old City or Nimman walk-in meal without a short vehicle ride.
duration: Allow about 60–90 minutes for a relaxed shared meal; this is a planning estimate.
cost: Most dishes are around ฿60–฿150 on the current venue menu; the northern appetizer platter is listed at ฿259. Recent diner listings show comparable prices, but menus and seasonal items can change. Budget roughly ฿150–฿350 per person depending on sharing and drinks (estimate).
hours: Daily 10:00–16:00 and 17:00–21:30 per the restaurant; confirm before travelling, especially around holidays.
bestTime: Go at opening for lunch or soon after 17:00 for dinner. December evenings are a good time to request outdoor seating if comfortable, while indoor air-conditioned seating is also reported.
gettingThere: At 63/9, behind Chiang Mai University, in Wat Umong Soi 4, Suthep. From the Old City or Nimman, use a metered taxi or ride-hail and enter the Thai name ฮ้านถึงเจียงใหม่ or the restaurant pin; allow roughly 10–20 minutes depending on traffic (estimate). The last leg is a local lane, so do not assume a convenient transit stop at the door. Parking is reported by diners.
booking: The restaurant invites enquiries and reservations by phone; call 093-970-6885 or 091-076-6100, or use its LINE link. No online reservation system or English-language booking guarantee was verified. Contact ahead for a large group or to check seasonal dishes.
accessibility: Air-conditioned indoor seating is reported by recent diners, alongside open-air seating. Step-free entry, accessible toilets, and wheelchair clearances are not documented; contact the restaurant to check specific needs. The menu is meat- and fish-heavy; some vegetable dishes appear, but vegetarian preparation and allergen controls are unverified.
practicalTips: Start with the northern appetizer platter (฿259 listed by Wongnai), then add a seasonal curry or vegetable dish; ask staff what is available that day.
Some local dishes use fermented pork, offal, fish, or strong chilli. State dietary restrictions clearly and ask about ingredients before ordering.
The restaurant site notes that recommended items and prices may change seasonally; carry the Thai name/address for the driver.
decemberNotes: The restaurant currently advertises year-round daily service and no special December 2026 event or holiday schedule was found. Reconfirm hours and availability close to your visit; seasonal northern dishes may vary.
uncertainties: December 2026 hours, prices and menu availability are not guaranteed by current listings.
No authoritative details found for step-free access, accessible toilets, English menu/service, or allergy and cross-contact procedures.
Travel time and ease of reaching the door vary with traffic and pickup point.
